text:
Alex: quick sweep on fused paged + FlashAttention for zeta-13B — can someone run a quick regression vs the current baseline? Noticed a small tail-latency bump on canary this morning.

Maria: sure — what baseline commit and what workloads (batch/seq) should we run?

Alex: baseline is main@c3f9b2d. Reproducer is the small perf harness in infra/perf/zeta. Target workloads: batch sizes [1,4,16], seq lengths [128,512,2048]. Focus on cold-start and steady-state p50/p95/p99.

Sam: I can run this on g4dn-8xlarge today. How long do you expect?

Alex: thanks @Sam. Each matrix (batch x seq) is ~6–8m steady-state, cold-start run add ~1m. Full sweep ~1.5h if you parallelize. Prioritize seq=2048 and batch=1 first (that's where we saw tail). :eyes:

Jyoti: pinging re: PR — is the fused-op branch the one to use or the patched runtime? I need the exact wheel/sha to repro.

Alex: use runtime-wheel build from ci/artifacts/2254/fused-paged-rt.whl (sha: a7e9f3). PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287.

Sam: got it. I'll kick off this command on the canary node: 
```bash
python infra/perf/run_sweep.py --model zeta-13B --wheel a7e9f3 --batches 1,4,16 --seqs 128,512,2048 --runs 5 --log runs/2255004321
```

Sam: also enabling nvtx and collecting nvprof traces for the 2048/1 case.

perf-bot: note — previous baseline (main@c3f9b2d) median/ p95 / p99 for zeta-13B (seq=2048, b=1): [median: 13.7ms, p95: 68.4ms, p99: 120.3ms].

Alex: perfect, please drop results + perf artifacts in this thread and tag me. If p99 > baseline p99 by >10% then mark as regression and assign to eng-runtime.

Sam: started run — first two quick checks (seq=2048,b=1) look similar to baseline but tail a bit wider. I'll post detailed numbers when finished. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: run started on canary-03 by Sam at 2255004330 — job id 2255-rt-007. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/runs/2255004321/ once complete.

Jyoti: if we see regression, we should also try disabling op-fusion to compare. I can do a follow-up job with fusion off (same wheel).

Sam: noted — running an unfused job queued next. ETA full sweep complete ~2255006000 (~28m).

Alex: sweet. Thanks everyone. Small ask: please include the nvprof flamegraph + nvtx timeline for the 2048/1 p99 sample so we can check kernel stalls.

Sam: will do, posting artifacts + quick summary when done.

perf-bot: reminder — please tag any regression with label "regression/attention-fusion" in the issue tracker so we can route alerting and postmortem if needed.

Alex: noted.

(End of thread)
